fields.name: id
fields.description: ASA message number (the NNNNNN in %ASA-S-NNNNNN). Pins a rule to a specific event type.

fields.name: srcip
fields.description: Source IP of the connection or the authenticating client.

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: L4 protocol of the denied/built connection.

fields.name: srcuser
fields.description: Account named in AAA auth events or CLI command events.

fields.name: command
fields.description: Privileged CLI command executed on the appliance.

fields.name: asa_severity
fields.description: ASA syslog severity digit (the S in %ASA-S-NNNNNN).

event_kinds.name: connection denied by ACL
event_kinds.example_line: %ASA-4-106023: Deny tcp src outside:203.0.113.7/51234 dst inside:10.0.0.5/3389 by access-group "outside_access_in"

event_kinds.name: AAA authentication rejected
event_kinds.example_line: %ASA-6-113005: AAA user authentication Rejected : reason = AAA failure : server = 10.0.0.2 : user = jdoe : user IP = 198.51.100.22

event_kinds.name: AAA authentication successful
event_kinds.example_line: %ASA-6-113012: AAA user authentication Successful : server = 10.0.0.2 : user = jdoe

event_kinds.name: privileged CLI command executed
event_kinds.example_line: %ASA-5-111010: User 'admin', running 'CLI' from IP 192.0.2.50, executed 'write memory'

notes: Regex flavor is PCRE2 (type="pcre2"). Standard fields (srcip/dstip/srcport/dstport/protocol/srcuser/id) used where possible so Wazuh's built-in firewall/auth rules and dashboards apply; command and asa_severity are dynamic (data.*). user IP is only present on rejected-auth lines, so srcip is event-kind dependent.
